outcome: neonatal head injuries related to birth trauma
cohort: 3377 singleton pregnancies delivered by vacuum extraction from 2014 to 2019 at gestational age ≥ 34 weeks
finding: Vacuum extraction in neonates weighing < 2500 g at 34 weeks gestation and beyond was associated with lower rates of head injury related to birth trauma compared to neonates with higher birth weights.
mod_finding: The study specifically examined vacuum extraction as a mode of delivery and found it to be associated with lower rates of head injury in lower birth weight infants.
